name: NX Horizon Source
subtitle: Nintendo Switch Horizon OS Frontend for iOS
description: NX Horizon is an experimental iOS frontend for Nintendo Switch game ports with LiveContainer integration. Recreates the authentic Horizon OS console UI, gamepad navigation, and direct-boot game launching.
